protocol.input: Unmodified publisher RescaleT(320) and ToTensorLab(flag=0), full original EXIF-oriented RGB. No corner, mask or ROI input.
protocol.target: Reviewed per-photo paper identity with unknown pixels excluded; synthetic original/scene/printed coverage from the same fixed 32 training geometries. Preserve fractional material coverage and source-pixel annotation uncertainty.
protocol.architecture: Freeze every parameter and buffer of the adapted U2NETP body. Reuse stage1d/2d/3d features through three 64-to-16 projections; combine with input RGB and frozen body scores in a two-layer 32-channel identity head at half resolution. Replace only the three RGB channels at the material head with body-confidence-weighted per-image centred colour, divided by one common RGB standard deviation. Confidence uses the normalized frozen body to power eight; no binary mask or material prediction enters colour statistics.
protocol.loss: Existing body loss plus known-material BCE, weighting a two-pixel Chebyshev band around known paper transitions by four; normalize per image by total weight, then choose one global A/B assignment. Exactly 50% coverage seeds both sides symmetrically. Unknown/background interfaces do not seed boundaries. Same frozen body and fractional labels.
protocol.augmentation: Independent horizontal and vertical reflection of input and target together.
protocol.checkpointSelection: Continue the fixed 120-update head for four complete synthetic epochs, with a fresh AdamW optimizer. Use only the final update; no validation-based selection.
protocol.inference: Publisher body preprocessing and min/max normalization unchanged. Material is sigmoid of the second raw logit, with no per-image material min/max normalization.
protocol.evaluation: Verify unchanged body outputs and inspect all training predictions; then evaluate the fixed final head on the 32 source-separated development photographs. No checkpoint or per-photo winner selection.
protocol.sampling: Each epoch visits all 96 synthetic views once in a fixed shuffled order; six shuffled passes through the 16 real training photos pair one real photo with each synthetic view. Reflections remain joint with targets.

scope: Paired loss-only continuation from the original fixed 120-update relative-colour head. Reuse the completed uniform-loss control: same architecture, initial weights, 384 draws, flips, optimizer, learning rate, input/label bytes, 16 real training photos and 96 synthetic views. Only boundary weighting changes. Final checkpoint only; no production changes.

comparison.validation: Require exact parent input/label hashes, initial head/body and metrics, all 384 draws and reflections matching the completed uniform-loss control. Measure all 96 synthetic views with the independent boundary diagnostic before deciding whether to run the native evaluation or fitter. Inspect training and worst synthetic views. No checkpoint selection.
